Title: LSJ: Stupid Josef von Bauren rules Q

Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:
Out of curiousity...

Josef von Bauren
Camarilla Nosferatu Inner Circle: You may use a discard phase action
to discard a card at random from your predator or prey's hand. +1
bleed. +1 stealth.

Camarilla Threat
If this referendum is successful, put this card in play. Each
Methuselah must pay an additional pool to use a discard phase action
to discard a card. Any vampire may call a referendum to burn this card
as a +1 stealth political action.

Does Josef's special count as 'using a discard phase action to discard
a card', since CT doesn't specify -whose- card must be getting
discarded, and thus cost Josef's controller a pool to use if CT is in
play?

-John Flournoy

Messages.Author: rob...@exploretalent.com
Messages.Body:


Well LSJ answered positive to this question:

"If I tap my Powerbase LA to use Josef's ability, and the card my
prey
discards at random is a card that requires an anarch, can I untap an
anarch?"

So it would seem that Josef's controller would take the penalty.
